timecoded_text_to_speech.text: In this experiment, we will coat a strip of copper with copper metal using electroplating method.
For this we will need a plastic or paper cup filled with water, copper sulfate salt, spatula or a nice cream stick to mix the salt in water,
two copper strips and a 9 volt battery connected to a battery snap and crocodile clips.
Prepare an atmosphere solution of copper sulfate by mixing a spatula full of copper sulfate salt with half a cup of water till it is dissolved.
Bend the copper strips around the rim of the cup such that their ends are immersed in the copper sulfate solution in the cup.
You can add some more water if the ends of the copper strips are not immersed in the atmosphere solution of copper sulfate.
Attach the crocodile clips connected to the 9 volt battery to the copper strips.
You will soon notice there is a coating starting to form on the negative electrode.
Let's take a closer look at what is happening here.
The process of depositing a layer of one metal on another material or metal through electricity is called electroplating.
When electric current is passed through the electrolyte, which is the atmosphere solution of copper sulfate, the copper sulfate salt breaks down into positive copper ions and negative sulfate ions.
The positive copper ions are attracted towards the negative electrode, which is the copper strip connected to the negative crocodile clip.
These copper ions from the electrolyte or copper sulfate solution form a coating of copper on the negative electrode.
As the amount of copper in the electrolyte decreases, it gets replenished by the copper strip connected to the positive terminal.
Essentially, in this process, the copper from the electrolyte gets coated on the negative terminal and the electrolyte gets replenished with copper from the positive terminal.

CAUTION: 
Experiments involving the use of sharp objects (knife, scissors, cutter, pins, etc.), or fire (spirit lamp, candles, matches) or any chemical must strictly done under the supervision of a Teacher or responsible adult. 
Chemistry experiments must be done in a well-ventilated room and Teachers must keep in mind if students in the class have any specific allergy that can be aggravated by fumes, smells, etc. 
Fill the spirit lamp only with surgical spirit easily available at medical stores or pharmacies. DO NOT fill it with any other type of fuel.

About India Literacy Project:
India Literacy Project, ILP, is a volunteer based non-profit organization dedicated to the cause of literacy in India. By empowering every individual we serve with functional literacy and an understanding of their basic rights and responsibilities, we strive to be a catalyst for 100% literacy in India.

About MDLS:
ILP's Multi-Dimensional Learning Space (MDLS) is a program that provides learning opportunities to school children to explore, experiment, discover, and learn in multiple ways. The concept of Schools as multi-dimensional learning spaces is based on the foundation that 1) Equal importance should be given to all aspects of the curriculum 2) Learning is not restricted to a curriculum. It should extend to help holistic and balanced development of a child 3) One learning style doesn't work for all and 4) Learning should involve visual, auditory and experiential methods.

About MDLS Science Experiment Kit: 
The Science Experiment Kit is one of the key elements of ILP’s Multi-Dimensional Learning Space (MDLS) program. MDLS has been enabling students to learn Science through hands-on experiments, showing learning Science can be simple, fun, inexpensive and can be done with items you can easily find around you, without many specialized or expensive equipment. The Kit contains material required to do experiments covering around 200+ concepts from 5th to 10th Grade across Physics, Chemistry and Biology.
